text: async function previewSou09Visible(id,y,limitMs=25000){ var before=(await fs.stat(sou09LogPath)).size; var started=Date.now(); await sky.scroll({window:case09Window,x:1018,y,scrollY:0,scrollX:0}); var match=null,chunk=''; while(Date.now()-started<limitMs){ chunk=(await fs.readFile(sou09LogPath)).subarray(before).toString('utf8'); if(/Syntax error|error in '|Access violation|CRT_INVALID_PARAMETER/i.test(chunk)) throw new Error('Native fault or observer error for Sou '+id); var requests=[...chunk.matchAll(/SOU_MENU_REQ seq=(\d+) tick=(\d+) meka=113 weapon=(\d+) variant=(\d+)/g)].filter(m=>Number(m[3])===id); for(var req of requests){var ready=new RegExp('SOU_MENU_READY seq='+req[1]+' start_seq=(\\d+) tick=(\\d+) meka=113 weapon='+id+' variant='+req[4]+' P=([0-9a-f]+) group=(\\d+) skill=(\\d+)').exec(chunk);if(ready){match={weapon:id,requestSeq:Number(req[1]),variant:Number(req[4]),startSeq:Number(ready[1]),readyTick:Number(ready[2]),actor:ready[3],group:Number(ready[4]),idleSkill:Number(ready[5])};break;}}if(match)break;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));}var snap=await sky.get_window_state({window:case09Window});var record={...match,requestedWeapon:id,closed:!!match,elapsedMs:Date.now()-started,logStart:before,logEnd:(await fs.stat(sou09LogPath)).size};sou09Records.push(record);await fs.writeFile(case09Evidence+'/sou-preview-'+String(id).padStart(3,'0')+'-'+Date.now()+'.jpg',Buffer.from(snap.screenshots[0].url.split(',')[1],'base64'),{flag:'wx'});nodeRepl.write(record);if(!match)throw new Error('No matched native READY for Sou '+id);return record;}
